scope: attack/E and attack/W only, 24 current formal PNGs
method: Every current full 1024 PNG was actually viewed individually in frame order.
E04-E07 were additionally compared in a shoulder/sleeve and leg/boot crop sheet.
Static frame and adjacent-frame visual assessment only; this reviewer did not perform or claim live playback.

frames.handsAndArms: Right crystal palm is raised beside the cheek; wrist enters its own near sleeve. Left hand supports the fox below its chest.
frames.legsAndFeet: Close stance; two softly bent knees connect to two rightward boots without a sole flip.

frames.handsAndArms: Crystal hand lowers toward the cheek during compression; left fox support remains visible and separate.
frames.legsAndFeet: Both knees compress over the close boots; no detached ankle or extra foot.

frames.handsAndArms: Right arm winds back with crystal near the shoulder; fox-supporting arm remains at chest.
frames.legsAndFeet: Stance opens for the attack: front and rear bent legs remain traceable to the skirt/hips; both boots retain the rightward attack plane.

frames.handsAndArms: Right near shoulder continues into the forward sleeve and crystal palm. Left fox support is occluded behind the crossing sleeve, with the fox retained at chest.
frames.legsAndFeet: Wide lunge has two boots; rear boot shows a three-quarter side view, front boot points right. No independent ankle reversal.

frames.handsAndArms: Forward right arm and palm remain connected; fox head remains above the crossing sleeve. No third cuff or hand.
frames.legsAndFeet: Rear boot becomes shorter and more frontal as the rear leg extends, while the front boot points right; the same rear-foot projection persists in E06, and ankle connection stays intact. Under the latest stricter support-axis criterion, this frontal rear-toe projection is now a repair target: it deviates from the E/rightward plane of E04/E07. Continuity over two frames does not establish correct alignment.
frames.recommendedAction: root to repair rear support boot toe/ankle only

confirmedRepairList.issue: Rear support boot toe faces down toward the viewer instead of following the E/rightward knee-ankle movement plane seen in E04/E07. The repeated projection in E05/E06 is insufficient justification under the latest stricter same-axis requirement.
confirmedRepairList.recommendedCorrection: Locally turn the rear boot toe and ankle connection toward E using E04/E07, preserving knee, lunge length and all upper-body pixels.

sequenceObservations.E: E01-E03 compression/windup, E04-E06 outward strike, E07-E08 recovery, E09-E12 settle. E05/E06 rear shoe uses a shorter frontal projection; checked against E04/E07, without confirmed disconnected ankle or isolated foot flip. Left fox-supporting arm is occluded behind the forward right sleeve during E04-E07. Latest criterion overrides the initial permissive foreshortening assessment: E05/E06 rear boot toe is pending root local correction.
sequenceObservations.W: W01-W03 windup, W04-W06 outward strike, W07-W09 recovery and W10-W12 ready. Both hands, two sleeves and two legs remain attributable across these poses.

limits: Sleeves and skirt hide parts of anatomical elbows and hips; observations use visible contour and adjacent-frame continuity.
No formal PNG, manifest, review/contact/status or global file was changed.
No old passed flag was used as evidence for this inspection.
criterionUpdate: Latest user criterion requires hip/knee/ankle/toe to share the movement plane; root independently confirmed E05/E06 rear boot outward deviation and owns the local edits. This audit remains bound to the pre-edit SHA until explicitly rechecked.
